# Tubeless Tyres

Tubeless tyres seal against the rim without an inner tube; liquid sealant plugs small punctures.

- Rim tape must cover every spoke hole.
- Sealant dries out; top up every three months.
- Running pressure too low causes burping, where air escapes past the bead on hard corners.

## Update 2026-11-05

Booster pumps make seating stubborn tyres much easier than a track pump.
